classification.difficultyReason: Foundation: a prepared student directly identifies the three age groups covering ages 50 or younger, reads their frequencies on the taught uniform scale and totals them. The inclusive boundary is explicit and requires no nontrivial reframing.

content.prompt: How many members of the triathlon club are 50 or younger?

spec.description: Five separated columns; stacked vertical-axis title, category labels, title, horizontal grid and between-category ticks retained. White interiors mask gridlines without decorative shading.
spec.mathematics: Age groups ≤30, 31–40, 41–50, 51–60 and >60 have frequencies 5, 9, 7, 5 and 2. The vertical scale is 0–10 in intervals of 2.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied graph data are visible; the calculated answer is stored only in the answer.

answer.worked:
The first three age groups include everyone aged 50 or younger.
$$5+9+7=21$$
There are $21$ members.
